newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Peugeot-Citroen unit issues PLN 25 mln CPs.
newsitem.headline: Polish Peugeot-Citroen unit issues PLN 25 mln CPs.

text.p: The Polish unit of France's Peugeot Citroen is offering 25 million zlotys of one-month commercial papers through the Polish branch of Societe Generale, a Societe Generale dealer said.
Bartlomiej Kumela told Reuters the bank was offering the paper, maturing October 31, 1996, with a yield of 18.75 percent.
The paper comes from a 30-million zloty borrowing programme managed jointly by Societe Generale and ING Bank Warsaw.
